Overview

[edit]

KCM Race Survival 2026 Season 1 (KCM 종족최강전 2026 시즌1) is the 37th season of KCM Race Survival and first season of 2026. It is organized by KCM and casted by him and PianO.

Format

[edit]
  • 8 weeks of regular race survival
    • Three Teams with three players each, with each team representing a race
    • All-kill format
    • 2 points for the winning team, 1 point for the runner-up
  • Two days of Playoffs
    • Semifinals:
      • Two Teams representing the two races that had the least success during regular season
      • Four players per team
      • All-Kill format
    • Finals:
      • Winner of the regular season and winner of the semifinals
      • Four players per team
      • All-Kill format

Prize pool

[edit]
  • Winner of the Season wins ₩4,000,000 and runner-up wins ₩600,000
  • Winner of each week of regular season wins ₩900,000 and runner-up wins ₩450,000
  • Regular All-Kill prize ₩600,000 + Skin care clinic ticket, Playoffs All-Kill prize ₩2,000,000.
